parsed.rationale_overall: Both systems deliver strongly personalized, risk-aligned, and well-diversified advice covering the same core issues (bond hold, cash excess, healthcare concentration). System A provides more concrete dollar amounts and specific ticker-level actions (better actionability), while System B avoids a questionable claim (A says JNJ pays ~$180k reduction from a 30% sector when JNJ is only part of that sector, and A's math on redistributing bonds while also keeping 50% is slightly inconsistent), giving B a small edge on factual grounding; overall the strengths offset.
